correction.title: Before correcting this match
correction.why: A side that has moved on from this match already played <matches></matches>, which is decided. So a correction that changes this match's result is rejected.
correction.how: To change the result, first correct a game in <matches></matches> until it is no longer decided, then come back here. Its games are voided when the sides change. If it led to another decided match, start with the latest one.
correction.howWalkover: <matches></matches> was decided by walkover, and correcting games doesn't undo the walkover. To change this match's result, you can only undo the start of the tournament.
correction.allowed: You can still correct the map or frags without changing the result.
